requestedOwnerFullFifoDiagnostic.note: Every complete owner passed the existing full FIFO, certified face mesh, drawable-face coverage, nested-composition, conflict, and bounded storage gates. IFC bounds and triangle counts remain diagnostics.

evidenceBoundary: RVT identity, ownership, host, level, type/family fields, frames, and bounds are decoded without IFC. The fixed 925-tag pre-tessellator corpus is preserved while exact RVT coverage and envelope gates measure the new production route. IFC is used only after decode as the geometry population, bounds, and triangle-count oracle.
